full_text:
ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Education and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 24423, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso Omitted>

Articles 2 through 6
Omitted.

Article 7 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through <72> Omitted.

<73> The Scholarship Regulations shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 3 (1) 1 and (3), Article 8, Article 9, and the main sentence of Article 15 (2), respectively, "Minister of Education, Science and Technology" shall be replaced with "Minister of Education."

In Articles 6 and 19, respectively, "Ordinance of the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology" shall be replaced with "Ordinance of the Ministry of Education."

<74> through <105> Omitted.
